units.name: Subscription Operations Lead
units.business_outcome: Coordinate evidence review, exceptions, owner decisions, and the portfolio subscription briefing.

units.name: Evidence Discovery Agent
units.business_outcome: Identify candidate subscription evidence from authorized sources without changing those sources.

units.name: Subscription Reconciliation Agent
units.business_outcome: Normalize, deduplicate, reconcile, and confidence-label subscription evidence.

units.name: Renewal and Spend Watcher
units.business_outcome: Flag renewals, trials, price changes, duplicate tools, low usage, and missing evidence.

units.name: Subscription Evidence and QA Agent
units.business_outcome: Prevent unsupported verification, secret retention, wrong-account merges, and unapproved authority expansion.

units.name: Subscription Baseline Workflow
units.business_outcome: Produce a draft Subscription Register batch, exception queue, and performance list from one manual evidence packet.

units.name: Subscription Policy and Metrics Engine
units.business_outcome: Enforce deterministic policy, idempotency, calculations, and telemetry.

approval_gates.g4: Build and inactive non-production execution only.
approval_gates.g5: Owner approval required before real authorized inbox evidence is processed.
approval_gates.g6: Owner approval required for any live write or external action.
